security_justification.audit_integrity: Only the example's fixed refusal naming changes; no event is newly admitted, discarded, rewritten or acknowledged by the collector.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Bearer parsing, synthetic fixture authentication and SDK validation are unchanged; capacity is still considered only after existing admission checks.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Sender identity and diagnostic authority remain collector-owned; the receiver matches the existing code without upgrading caller input to authority.
security_justification.concurrency: No reservation or concurrency changes; the existing synchronous ledger and request lifecycle remain intact.
security_justification.confidentiality: The response exposes only a fixed capacity reason, never event contents, credentials or supplied data.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive or identifier generation changes; positive probes use fresh random UUIDs through the existing helper.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The new body is exactly the bounded deduplication_capacity constant; no diagnostic paths or caller data cross the wire.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security service is added; verification uses disposable installed kits and loopback-only synthetic receivers.
security_justification.fail_posture: The capacity refusal remains fail-closed with no admission; unknown diagnostics retain the 500 ingress_rejected fallback.
security_justification.lifecycle: No receiver or SDK lifecycle policy changes; the isolated probe cleans its child in finally and retains existing health semantics.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Collector ledger ownership and event copying remain unchanged; source mutation exists only in the existing disposable negative-control harness.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: SDK validation and sanitization are unchanged; probes clone synthetic valid fixtures with fresh identifiers.
security_justification.resource_retention: The no-storage cap remains 32 identities for 300 s as ratified by #478; no storage, cap, clock or retention edits occur.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Shared 429 classification remains http_retryable/SDK_SINK_FAILURE; no automatic retry or Retry-After reading is added, and admitted duplicates still acknowledge.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Only the example's mapping of a trusted collector diagnostic to a fixed HTTP answer changes; request parsing and ingress trust boundaries remain intact.
